data.title: The Ritz-Carlton Residences RAK
data.about:
Exclusive collection of villas, The Ritz-Carlton Residences Ras Al Khaimah, Al Wadi Desert is a beautiful luxury residential community located in the stunning Al Wadi Desert, Ras Al Khaimah. Properties in the development are presented by 3–5 bedroom villas with private swimming pools and all the privacy you could ever need. 

Property owners can enjoy signature services by the world-renowned hotel brand Ritz Carlton, including housekeeping services and restaurant reservations in venues that overlook the endless desert dunes. Discover exclusive living at the Ritz-Carlton Residences, Ras Al Khaimah, Al Wadi Desert. 

Situated on the stunning al wadi dunes of the northern emirate of Ras al Khaimah, these luxurious residences are designed to offer the perfect combination of modern amenities in the lap of traditional Arabian hospitality. Enjoy breathtaking views of the desert from your terrace-class Ritz Carlton signature services next door.

location_tile.title: Reside in a Desert Hideaway at Al Wadi Desert
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Experience a luxurious lifestyle in the stunning Al Wadi Desert of Ras Al Khaimah. Here, you can escape the hustle and bustle of daily life while enjoying the comforts of home, but with a luxurious twist. Each residence, part of The Ritz Carlton at Al Wadi Desert, is a masterpiece of elegant design, offering breathtaking views of the tranquil desert. The Ritz-Carlton Residences are more than just homes; they're retreats where every detail caters to your desire for the finer things in life.

  •  Ras Al Khaimah Airport  - 23.1KM
  • Sharjah International Airport  -  61.5KM
  • Dubai International Airport - 83.8KM
